Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Qwen3-VL vision modules could not correctly use ModelOpt NVFP4 weights.

There were three related issues:

1. Qwen3-VL always disabled `quant_config` for the vision model, so vision linear layers were built as BF16 layers even when the checkpoint provided ModelOpt FP4 metadata and packed weights.
2. The ModelOpt W4A4 FP4 linear path only accepted 2D inputs, while Qwen3-VL vision attention can pass tensors with leading dimensions such as `[B, S, K]`.
3. ModelOpt mixed-precision dispatch and exclusion checks did not consistently resolve `model.visual.*` and `visual.*` aliases, so vision metadata, skip rules, and packed module mappings could disagree after weight-name mapping.

This PR enables the supported ModelOpt quantization paths for Qwen3-VL vision while keeping other quantization backends disabled for vision.

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Modifications

1. Forward ModelOpt vision quant configs in `qwen3_vl.py`
   - Pass `quant_config` into `Qwen3VLMoeVisionModel` only for `modelopt_fp4` and `modelopt_mixed`.
   - Keep the previous `None` behavior for other quantization backends.
   - Fix Qwen3-VL weight-name mapping from `model.visual` to `visual`, including root, glob, and nested layer names.

2. Support Qwen3-VL vision prefixes in ModelOpt quantization
   - Add shared prefix candidates for `model.visual.*` and `visual.*`.
   - Apply the alias handling to uniform ModelOpt FP4 exclusions, mixed-precision metadata dispatch, packed-module skip checks, and vision position embedding handling.

3. Preserve leading dimensions in W4A4 FP4 linear apply
   - Flatten `[..., K]` inputs to `[M, K]` before FP4 quantization and GEMM.
   - Restore the output to `[..., N]`.
   - Preserve the existing flattened contract for pre-quantized tuple inputs.
   - Keep W4A16 and Marlin behavior unchanged.

4. Add regression tests
   - Add CPU unit coverage for W4A4 leading-dimension inputs, non-contiguous inputs, bias handling, AWQ pre-quant scaling, and pre-quantized tuple inputs.
   - Add Qwen3-VL tests for ModelOpt vision config forwarding, visual weight-name mapping, uniform exclusions, fused QKV split exclusions, mixed precision dispatch, and vision position embedding dispatch.
   - Add CUDA backend regression coverage for leading-dimension NVFP4 linear inputs against a dequantized reference.

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

## Accuracy Tests

This PR is a loading, dispatch, and shape-support fix. It does not intentionally change the math for already-supported 2D inputs.

Local CPU/unit validation:

```bash
python -m py_compile \
  python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/modelopt_quant.py \
  python/sglang/srt/models/qwen3_vl.py \
  test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_modelopt_nvfp4.py \
  test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_nvfp4_linear_backends.py \
  test/registered/unit/models/test_qwen3_vl_modelopt_vision.py
```

Targeted CPU regression result:

```text
73 passed, 97 subtests passed
```

Static and registration checks:

```bash
ruff format --check
ruff check --select=F401,F821,F823,UP037
isort --check-only
scripts/lint/check_registered_tests.py
scripts/lint/check_no_bare_pytest_main.py
git diff --check
```

The CUDA/B200 NVFP4 backend regression test was added, but it was not executed locally because this machine does not have the required CUDA/B200/FlashInfer backend environment.

+"""Regression tests for ModelOpt quantization in the Qwen3 vision tower."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.linear import ReplicatedLinear
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.modelopt_quant import (
+    ModelOptFp4Config,
+    ModelOptFp4LinearMethod,
+    ModelOptMixedPrecisionConfig,
+    ModelOptNvFp4EmbeddingMethod,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.unquant import UnquantizedLinearMethod
+from sglang.srt.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import VocabParallelEmbedding
+from sglang.srt.models import qwen3_vl
+from sglang.srt.models.qwen3_vl import Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _NamedQuantConfig:
+    def __init__(self, name):
+        self.name = name
+
+    def get_name(self):
+        return self.name
+
+
+class TestQwen3VisionQuantConfig(CustomTestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def _construct_outer_model(quant_config):
+        config = SimpleNamespace(
+            language_model_only=False,
+            encoder_only=True,
+            language_only=False,
+            vision_config=SimpleNamespace(deepstack_visual_indexes=[]),
+            text_config=SimpleNamespace(rope_scaling={}),
+        )
+        parallel = SimpleNamespace(
+            pp_group=SimpleNamespace(is_last_rank=True, world_size=1)
+        )
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(qwen3_vl, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel),
+            patch.object(
+                qwen3_vl,
+                "get_mm",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(mm_enable_dp_encoder=False),
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                qwen3_vl,
+                "Qwen3VLMoeVisionModel",
+                return_value=nn.Module(),
+            ) as vision_cls,
+            patch.object(qwen3_vl, "LogitsProcessor", return_value=nn.Module()),
+            patch.object(qwen3_vl, "Pooler", return_value=nn.Module()),
+        ):
+            Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration(
+                config,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                language_model_cls=object,
+            )
+        return vision_cls
+
+    def test_only_modelopt_configs_are_forwarded_to_vision(self):
+        for name in ("modelopt_fp4", "modelopt_mixed"):
+            with self.subTest(name=name):
+                quant_config = _NamedQuantConfig(name)
+                vision_cls = self._construct_outer_model(quant_config)
+
+                self.assertIs(vision_cls.call_args.kwargs["quant_config"], quant_config)
+
+        for name in ("fp8", "gptq", "bitsandbytes"):
+            with self.subTest(name=name):
+                vision_cls = self._construct_outer_model(_NamedQuantConfig(name))
+                self.assertIsNone(vision_cls.call_args.kwargs["quant_config"])
+
+        vision_cls = self._construct_outer_model(None)
+        self.assertIsNone(vision_cls.call_args.kwargs["quant_config"])
+
+
+class TestQwen3VisionModelOptPrefixes(CustomTestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def _mixed_config(*, exclude_modules=None):
+        quant_config = ModelOptMixedPrecisionConfig.from_config(
+            {
+                "quant_algo": "MIXED_PRECISION",
+                "exclude_modules": list(exclude_modules or []),
+                "quantized_layers": {
+                    "model.visual.blocks.0.attn.q_proj": {
+                        "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+                        "group_size": 16,
+                    },
+                    "model.visual.blocks.0.attn.k_proj": {
+                        "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+                        "group_size": 16,
+                    },
+                    "model.visual.blocks.0.attn.v_proj": {
+                        "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+                        "group_size": 16,
+                    },
+                    "model.visual.blocks.0.mlp.linear_fc1": {
+                        "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+                        "group_size": 16,
+                    },
+                    "model.visual.pos_embed": {
+                        "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+                        "group_size": 16,
+                    },
+                },
+                "packed_modules_mapping": {
+                    "qkv_proj": ["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj"],
+                },
+            }
+        )
+        quant_config.apply_weight_name_mapper(
+            Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.hf_to_sglang_mapper
+        )
+        return quant_config
+
+    def test_mapper_handles_visual_root_glob_and_layer_names(self):
+        mapper = Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.hf_to_sglang_mapper
+        cases = {
+            "model.visual": "visual",
+            "model.visual*": "visual*",
+            "model.visual.*": "visual.*",
+            "model.visual.blocks.0.attn.q_proj": ("visual.blocks.0.attn.q_proj"),
+        }
+
+        for source, expected in cases.items():
+            with self.subTest(source=source):
+                self.assertEqual(mapper._map_name(source), expected)
+
+    def test_uniform_visual_exclusions_survive_mapping(self):
+        cases = {
+            "model.visual": "visual",
+            "model.visual*": "visual*",
+            "model.visual.*": "visual.*",
+            "model.visual.blocks.0.mlp.linear_fc1": ("visual.blocks.0.mlp.linear_fc1"),
+        }
+
+        for source, expected in cases.items():
+            with self.subTest(source=source):
+                quant_config = ModelOptFp4Config(
+                    is_checkpoint_nvfp4_serialized=True,
+                    group_size=16,
+                    exclude_modules=[source],
+                )
+                quant_config.apply_weight_name_mapper(
+                    Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.hf_to_sglang_mapper
+                )
+
+                self.assertEqual(quant_config.exclude_modules, [expected])
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    quant_config.is_layer_excluded(
+                        "model.visual.blocks.0.mlp.linear_fc1"
+                    )
+                )
+
+    def test_uniform_fused_visual_qkv_honors_split_exclusions(self):
+        split_layers = [
+            f"model.visual.blocks.0.attn.{projection}"
+            for projection in ("q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj")
+        ]
+        linear = ReplicatedLinear.__new__(ReplicatedLinear)
+
+        quant_config = ModelOptFp4Config(
+            is_checkpoint_nvfp4_serialized=True,
+            group_size=16,
+            exclude_modules=split_layers,
+            packed_modules_mapping={
+                "qkv_proj": ["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj"],
+            },
+        )
+        quant_config.apply_weight_name_mapper(
+            Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.hf_to_sglang_mapper
+        )
+        method = quant_config.get_quant_method(
+            linear, "model.visual.blocks.0.attn.qkv_proj"
+        )
+        self.assertIsInstance(method, UnquantizedLinearMethod)
+
+        partial = ModelOptFp4Config(
+            is_checkpoint_nvfp4_serialized=True,
+            group_size=16,
+            exclude_modules=split_layers[:1],
+            packed_modules_mapping={
+                "qkv_proj": ["q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj"],
+            },
+        )
+        partial.apply_weight_name_mapper(
+            Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration.hf_to_sglang_mapper
+        )
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "some but not all shards"):
+            partial.get_quant_method(linear, "model.visual.blocks.0.attn.qkv_proj")
+
+    def test_mixed_visual_metadata_dispatches_quantized_methods(self):
+        quant_config = self._mixed_config()
+        linear = ReplicatedLinear.__new__(ReplicatedLinear)
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            quant_config.resolve_quant_algo("model.visual.blocks.0.attn.qkv_proj"),
+            "NVFP4",
+        )
+        self.assertIsInstance(
+            quant_config.get_quant_method(
+                linear, "model.visual.blocks.0.attn.qkv_proj"
+            ),
+            ModelOptFp4LinearMethod,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            quant_config.resolve_quant_algo("model.visual.blocks.0.mlp.linear_fc1"),
+            "NVFP4",
+        )
+        self.assertIsInstance(
+            quant_config.get_quant_method(
+                linear, "model.visual.blocks.0.mlp.linear_fc1"
+            ),
+            ModelOptFp4LinearMethod,
+        )
+
+    def test_mixed_visual_position_embedding_dispatches_and_excludes(self):
+        embedding = VocabParallelEmbedding.__new__(VocabParallelEmbedding)
+        quant_config = self._mixed_config()
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            quant_config.resolve_quant_algo("model.visual.pos_embed"), "NVFP4"
+        )
+        self.assertIsInstance(
+            quant_config.get_quant_method(embedding, "model.visual.pos_embed"),
+            ModelOptNvFp4EmbeddingMethod,
+        )
+
+        excluded = self._mixed_config(exclude_modules=["model.visual.pos_embed"])
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            excluded.get_quant_method(embedding, "model.visual.pos_embed")
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
